When you touch it, a hint about a Pokémon’s <$cdef(27)>habitat will

<$cdef(27)>Traces of Pokémon often appear near places that a specific
Pokémon might like.

Look closely at the place where you found the trace and
compare it to the hints you’ve received.
Think carefully about what kind of habitat you should
make to meet a new Pokémon!

Press the <$keyicon(4)> button to open the main menu, then select
<$cdef(27)>Habitat Dex to view all the hints you’ve gathered!
You got a <$cdef(27)><fqty(1)><$ifull(95)></color>!
<$voicel(1,9)><$comeff(1,3)>Oho! If it isn’t a <$cdef(27)>building kit</color>!
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,9)><$facial(1,4)>Humans used these items to put up buildings.

<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,13)><$facial(1,9)>But construction is a complicated process.
<$voicel(1,4)>I’m not certain we could <$cdef(27)><$spwfull(1)> something like that all
on our own...

Thanks to the Pokémon who helped you out, you managed
to <$cdef(27)><$spwfull(1)> a house!
Now it’s time to turn it into a comfy place to live!

After you set the <$cdef(27)>building kit in place, gather the <$cdef(27)>materials
and some<$cdef(27)> Pokémon to help out.
Then, they’ll begin to <$cdef(27)><$spwfull(1)>!

Talk to the Pokémon you’d like to help you out and bring
them here.
Don’t forget that you’ll need a Pokémon like <$cdef(27)>Timburr who’s
good at <$cdef(27)><$spwfull(1)>ing!

To rebuild the <$cdef(27)>Pokémon Center, you’ll need help from a
Pokémon who has the <$cdef(27)><$spwfull(33)> specialty.
Find one and get them to help you out!

<$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,5)>I suppose we’ll have to start by clearing this rubble so
we can <$cdef(27)><$spwfull(33)> it.
<$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,7)>I suspect a Pokémon who’s <$cdef(27)>large and hard like a boulder
might be able to help you <$cdef(27)><$spwfull(33)>!

<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,7)>As for where a Pokémon like that might prefer to live...
<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,7)>Perhaps a rocky place, like a <$cdef(27)>cave?

<$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,7)>Thanks to your efforts, Pokémon are gradually returning!
<$comeff(1,5)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,664)><$voicel(1,9)>I expect that sooner or later, we’ll run into a Pokémon who
can <$cdef(27)><$spwfull(33)>!

You can use the <$cdef(27)><$ifull(2793)> to find hidden
things, such as objects buried in the ground!
To use it, hold the <$cdef(27)><$ifull(2793)> in your hands and
talk to a Pokémon who specializes in <$cdef(27)><$spwfull(11)>ing!
*ring ring!*

<$voicel(1,1)><$emotion(1,31)><$facial(1,9)>Good grief. I can’t make heads or tails of this <$cdef(27)>PC...
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,16)>Wait... Why do I see <$cdef(27)>?

<$voicel(1,9)><$emotion(1,15)>Wha—?! You can see me too, <$cdef(27)>?!
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,32)>Fascinating! It seems this <$cdef(27)>PC is somehow capable <$voicel(1,8)>of
communicating with that Pokédex you’re carrying!

<$voicel(1,9)><$emotion(1,32)>Hoho! I seem to have gotten the knack of this <$cdef(27)>PC!
<$voicel(1,8)>Now, let’s see... What happens if I push—
Call ended.
*ring ring!*

<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,9)>Seems like I shouldn’t go pushing buttons willy-nilly!
<$voicel(1,9)><$emotion(1,1)>Anyhoo, I’ll contact you again another time. You be
careful out there!

*beep beep beep*
You have arrived at an area gate.
Please place your Pokédex over the gate panel.
*ring ring!*

<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,25)>Hellooo? Can you hear me, <$cdef(27)>?
Whereabouts
are
you now?
<$voicel(1,8)><$emotion(1,14)>Oh, that looks like...near the gate, right?

<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,13)>Hmmm... As far as I can recall, the only folks who were able
to get through that gate back in the day <$voicel(1,6)>were humans
known as Professors or Trainers.

<$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,5)>You look like a Trainer yourself, you know.
<$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,9)>So you may be able to pass through there at some point!

*beep beep beep*
You have arrived at an area gate.
Please place your Pokédex over the gate panel.
*ring ring!*

<$voicel(1,9)><$emotion(1,32)>Oho! It seems you can pass through the gate
now, <$cdef(27)>!

<$comeff(1,6)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)>I wonder what lies beyond it.
<$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,7)>Perhaps there are scads of Pokémon and humans living
there!

<$voicel(1,9)><$emotion(1,2)>Promise me that when you do go through that gate, you’ll
bring me along, you hear?
